sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:174961
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 40816 of 2024

Applicant :- Smt Sumitra
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Mahadeo Singh Chandel,Rakesh Kumar Gupta,Yogiraj Swami
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

1. Heard Sri M.S. Chandel, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Manoj Kumar Singh, learned Brief Holder for the State.
2.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.79 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Marka,
District-Banda, during pendency of the trial.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, she has been made accused along with her other family members including husband of the deceased.
4. He further submits that actually even after three years of her marriage, deceased could not be conceived, therefore, only due to this reason under depression, she committed suicide by hanging herself and post mortem report of the deceased also suggests that deceased died due to hanging.
5. He further submits that applicant is a lady and there is no specific allegation against her and she is not having any criminal history and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 2.7.2024.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submits that daughter-in-law of the applicant died within three years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry, but could not dispute the fact that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her.
He further could not dispute the fact that as per postmortem report, deceased died due to hanging.
7. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

8. However, daughter-in-law of the applicant died within seven years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry, but the applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her.
9. Further, postmortem report suggests that deceased died due to hanging, therefore, prima facie it appears to be a case of suicidal death.
10. Further, applicant is a lady and she is in jail in the present matter since 2.7.2024.

11. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicant - Smt. Sumitra be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless her personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
14.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

15. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 7.11.2024/LN Tripathi  Smt Sumitra vs State Of U.P. on 7 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12651342/
